C0883.title: IBM Report Reveals Surge in Automated Credential Theft
C0883.summary: According to IBM's 2025 X-Force Threat Intelligence Index, phishing emails containing infostealers increased by 84% in 2024, with attackers leveraging AI for large-scale distribution, making credential theft account for nearly one-third of all security incidents. Infostealers can rapidly harvest login information, shorten attack time, and bypass multi-factor authentication.
